metadata.notes: Genuine QAOA workflow with explicit Hamiltonian circuit execution. No quantum advantage claimed; NISQ simulation compares favorably in sampling diversity but has circuit overhead relative to exact classical solver.

default.synthetic_notice: All scenario data is SYNTHETIC. Nothing here is live or measured municipal data and no claim is made about any real water network.
default.seed_note: In the engine, the seed controls only shot sampling; parameter optimisation is deterministic, so seed variability understates optimiser-initialisation variability.
limitations: Single tiny synthetic instance (7 decision bits, 12 qubits with slack): results do not generalise and are not evidence of quantum advantage.
QAOA is run by noiseless statevector simulation on a classical computer; its runtime is simulation cost, not hardware runtime.
The exact solver enumerates 2^7 decision patterns; QAOA works in a 2^12 space with slack qubits. Runtimes are not a like-for-like comparison.
The engine reports the best sampled feasible bitstring (classical post-selection over shots), not the modal one. Modal results are reported separately.
